The reusable CI suite is implemented, but no release caller uses it and the contract does not detect that absence.

1. [blocking, issue-impact] The release workflow never calls the reusable CI workflow. [`release.yml`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.github/workflows/release.yml:14) starts artifact jobs from `version-contract` only, and there is no `uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml` anywhere under `.github/workflows`. Thus a tag can build and publish without the Rust, web, MCP, repository-validation, or exact-MSRV suites required by the issue and `@/issue/b80e3c70/requirement/REQ-09`.

2. [blocking, issue-impact] The new verifier cannot detect that omission: [`check_caller_obligation`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/scripts/workflow-contract.py:727) returns without a finding when no workflow calls `ci.yml`. The contract therefore validates a release graph that entirely bypasses normal validation, rather than asserting the required release caller and its downstream `needs` boundary.
